description: The table a report's chart is drawn from: the datasheet's steps run over the copies stored at its sources' last reads; the source is never queried. Only the report's editors may: the table was read with an editor's credentials, can hold columns and rows the slides never show, and skips the source's row-level security. Fails for a `picture` datasheet (its `kind` in `listReportDatasheets`), which has no table. Also fails until every source it reads has been read, after a source's latest read failed, and once a stored copy expires, 30 days after its read. At most 30 reads a minute per user.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

datasheetId.description: The datasheet whose table to read: an `id` from `listReportDatasheets`, or one of the `datasheetIds` returned by `addReportDatasheets`. It must be one of this report's datasheets. A datasheet that reads a picture, such as a dashboard tab added with `addReportDatasheets`, has no table, so the request fails: add the tab's charts as data with `addReportDashboardElements`.

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.

query.description: Options for the call, such as filters, paging or how long to wait

limit.description: The maximum number of rows to return, starting from the first row of the table. If the table has more, `truncated` is `true`. Can range from `1` to `1000`. Defaults to `200`.

name: getReportDatasheetData
title: Get datasheet data
